Located in vibrant Coney Island these residences feature contemporary finishes, bright layouts, and quality craftsmanship built for comfort and ease. With easy access to the beach, dining, and multiple subway lines, residents enjoy the perfect balance of beachside living and city convenience. This project is pet friendly and smoke free. Tenants are responsible to pay for electricity of the apartment, which includes electric stove and heat. The rent includes hot water.
